Orange seams/sacs are their glowing orange colour only, without illumination of nearby surfaces or bloom.

Gold reads as gold through colour and restrained wear, not mirror reflections. Preserve shape edges through material boundaries and subtle colour texture rather than lighting. No background, floor, checkerboard pixels, vignette, text, watermark or border. Keep all surrounding space and all guide openings truly transparent.
